body:
# ![Full logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f86564ddc8f84539e1c731b2edcccd2bdbaa0163.png)

_"Oh, it’s just another Vanilla+ modpack… wow… so original…"_
yeah yeah, I know But hold up before you scroll.

YAV+ isn’t just “Vanilla with a few random mods.”
This is a carefully curated Vanilla+ experience made to enhance Minecraft without ruining its original vibe.

This modpack focuses on:
- ✅ Cleaner, fresher visuals (still feels 100% Minecraft)
- ✅ More lively animations (mobs, items, small world details)
- ✅ More immersive sound
- ✅ Addictive little details (3D items, particles, trims, etc.)
- ✅ Still lightweight & perfect for survival worlds

No weird mechanics.
No overcomplicated systems.
No “this doesn’t feel like Minecraft anymore” moments.
Just…

Minecraft, but prettier, smoother, and more alive. ✨

### 🎯 Inspiration
This modpack is inspired by several popular Vanilla+ packs such as
[Vanilla Perfected](https://modrinth.com/modpack/vanilla-perfected) by DemonJoeTV and [Fresh & Smooth](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fresh-smooth) by EnderPacks.

Because of that, you can consider YAV+ as a lite version of those packs 
simpler, lighter, and focused on visual & QoL improvements only, i mean… this was made on a potato device, so it HAD to be light.

### 🔧 Recommended RAM Allocation
Since this is a Vanilla+ modpack (not a 300-mod monster), the requirements are pretty friendly:

- 🧠 Recommended: 4 – 6 GB RAM
- 🧠 Optimal / Safest: 6 – 8 GB RAM
- 🧠 Minimum: 3 – 4 GB RAM (no shaders / light shaders only)

Using heavy shaders or max settings?
- ➜ Go for 8 GB for a smoother experience.
Using light shaders or no shaders?
- ➜ 4–6 GB is more than enough.

### 📌 Note
This is actually my personal modpack and my first modpack that i post, but I wanted to share my experience with you all.
Feel free to add any other mods/resource pack into this modpack and make it your own.
But if your game crashes… you're on your own, don’t blame me for that :P
In the gallery, I’m using the [Stay True](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/stay-true) texture pack from CurseForge. (bug warning)
You can add it yourself too or use any texture pack you prefer!
